description: Frontend pages and UI components - Create all Next.js App Router pages, layouts, and React components for the marketplace. This includes the landing page, instructor and student onboarding flows, dashboard pages, booking interface, messaging, and all shared UI components.
steps: Create src/app/layout.tsx - Root layout with HTML structure, font loading, Tailwind classes, navigation header, and session provider wrapper

Create src/app/page.tsx - Landing page with hero section (headline about finding the perfect driving instructor), feature highlights (smart matching, progress tracking, continuity guarantee), how it works steps, CTA buttons for instructors and students
Create src/app/globals.css - Tailwind directives and custom global styles
Create src/components/ui/Button.tsx - Reusable button component with variants (primary, secondary, outline, danger), sizes, loading state
Create src/components/ui/Card.tsx - Card component with header, body, footer slots
Create src/components/ui/Input.tsx - Form input with label, error state, helper text
Create src/components/ui/Select.tsx - Select dropdown with label and error state
Create src/components/ui/Badge.tsx - Badge/tag component for skills, specialisms
Create src/components/ui/Avatar.tsx - Avatar component with fallback initials
Create src/components/ui/Modal.tsx - Modal dialog component
Create src/components/ui/Calendar.tsx - Calendar/date picker component for availability
Create src/components/ui/ProgressBar.tsx - Visual progress bar for skill tracking
Create src/components/layout/Header.tsx - Site header with navigation, auth state, role-based menu items
Create src/components/layout/Footer.tsx - Site footer with links
Create src/components/layout/Sidebar.tsx - Dashboard sidebar navigation
Create src/app/auth/signin/page.tsx - Sign in page with email/password form, links to register
Create src/app/auth/register/instructor/page.tsx - Multi-step instructor registration (personal info, ADI verification, profile setup, availability, Stripe connect)
Create src/app/auth/register/student/page.tsx - Student registration with preference setup (location, gender pref, language, teaching style, car type, anxiety-friendly, goals)
Create src/app/dashboard/layout.tsx - Dashboard layout with sidebar navigation
Create src/app/dashboard/page.tsx - Dashboard home with role-based redirect
Create src/app/dashboard/instructor/page.tsx - Instructor dashboard with upcoming bookings, earnings summary, profile completeness, recent reviews
Create src/app/dashboard/instructor/availability/page.tsx - Availability management with weekly calendar view, add/edit/delete time slots, recurring slots
Create src/app/dashboard/instructor/bookings/page.tsx - Instructor bookings list with status filters, cancel/confirm actions
Create src/app/dashboard/instructor/earnings/page.tsx - Earnings overview with Stripe balance, payout history, commission breakdown
Create src/app/dashboard/instructor/profile/page.tsx - Instructor profile edit page
Create src/app/dashboard/student/page.tsx - Student dashboard with next lesson, progress overview, matched instructors
Create src/app/dashboard/student/matches/page.tsx - Smart match results showing top instructor matches with compatibility scores and breakdown
Create src/app/dashboard/student/bookings/page.tsx - Student bookings list (upcoming, past, cancelled)
Create src/app/dashboard/student/progress/page.tsx - Visual progress dashboard showing skills learned, lesson history, instructor notes
Create src/app/dashboard/messages/page.tsx - In-app messaging interface with conversation list and chat view
Create src/app/instructors/[id]/page.tsx - Public instructor profile page with reviews, availability preview, book button
Create src/app/booking/[instructorId]/page.tsx - Booking flow page (select date/time, confirm, payment via Stripe)
Create src/components/matching/MatchCard.tsx - Card showing instructor match with score breakdown
Create src/components/matching/MatchFilters.tsx - Filter controls for match results
Create src/components/booking/BookingCard.tsx - Booking summary card
Create src/components/booking/TimeSlotPicker.tsx - Time slot selection grid
Create src/components/progress/SkillChart.tsx - Visual skill progress chart
Create src/components/progress/LessonLog.tsx - Lesson history with notes
Create src/components/reviews/ReviewCard.tsx - Review display card with rating stars
Create src/components/reviews/ReviewForm.tsx - Review submission form
Create src/components/messages/ConversationList.tsx - List of message conversations
Create src/components/messages/ChatWindow.tsx - Chat message window
acceptance_criteria: All page files exist under src/app/ with proper Next.js App Router conventions
All components are properly typed with TypeScript interfaces for props
Client components are marked with 'use client' directive where needed (forms, interactive elements)
Server components are used by default for data-fetching pages
Landing page communicates the value proposition clearly
Dashboard pages are role-gated (instructor vs student views)
All forms include proper validation display
Components follow a consistent design system using Tailwind classes
verification: Verify all page and component files exist with find command
Check that TypeScript syntax is valid across key files
Verify client/server component directives are properly placed
